title: Measurement (neutral BenchBoard contract)
description: One measured, entered, derived or unavailable value with an honest unit and source. measurementKind, value and source must tell one consistent story: an UNAVAILABLE measurement is exactly null for value and source (never zero, so 'not sampled' cannot masquerade as 'zero'); a measured or entered value names a local record ID/digest or a named procedure, and an entered value cannot be dressed up as computed. Source references are local records: exported private absolute paths, tokens, cookies and credentials are never carried here.

schemaVersion.$comment: Schema major is the discriminator; only major 1 is read and unknown majors are rejected, never coerced.

measurementKind.$comment: The record-level name of the architecture's provenance axis (measured | entered | derived | unavailable), mapped one to one.

value.$comment: Exactly null for UNAVAILABLE; a finite number otherwise. null is never silently replaced by zero.

source.$comment: Exactly null for UNAVAILABLE (an unmeasured value claims no source); otherwise names where the value came from.

recordId.$comment: A local record identifier, validated against the result's own bindings by the runtime.

digest.$comment: A local digest, validated against the digests bound by the surrounding result.

derivation.$comment: One stable representation: a DERIVED measurement's formula string, e.g. '{totalTokens} / {elapsedWallSeconds}', validated, persisted and revalidated as the same string. minLength plus this pattern enforce the exact shared grammar as a structural gate: at least one whole {metricName} token whose name matches the metric grammar, literal text without braces elsewhere, every { and } belonging to exactly one token — an empty, placeholder-free, whitespace-only or unmatched/nested-brace formula is refused identically by the runtime (packages/core/manifest.mjs derivationProblems) and its helper parseDerivation. The runtime adds only the semantic extras it discloses: repeated inputs and the measurementKind coupling (DERIVED requires, others refuse) are the runtime's job, not the pattern's.

confidence.$comment: Optional 0..1 honesty weight; absent or null stays absent, never zero.
